study_plans.title: Accessible Web Foundations
study_plans.content:
Learning goal: Review semantic HTML, responsive layouts, and browser accessibility tools. Build a mobile-friendly page, test keyboard navigation, and document accessibility improvements.

Four-week schedule:
Week 1 — Review foundational concepts and complete guided exercises.
Week 2 — Apply the concepts in a small hands-on implementation.
Week 3 — Test, refine, and document the completed work.
Week 4 — Review outcomes, identify gaps, and prepare for assessment.

Completion criteria: Submit working examples, document key decisions, and demonstrate understanding through a short reflection.
